worked_solution:
To integrate a vector-valued function, we integrate each componentt separately:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{4}⟨2t-1,\,\frac{1}{2\sqrt{t}}⟩\text{d}t & =⟨{\int }_{1}^{4}(2t-1)\,\text{d}t,{\int }_{1}^{4}\frac{1}{2\sqrt{t}}\,\text{d}t⟩ \\  & =⟨({t}^{2}-t)\,\,{|}_{1}^{4},\,\sqrt{t}\,\,{|}_{1}^{4}\,\,⟩ \\  & =⟨\text{ }({4}^{2}-4)-({1}^{2}-1),\,\sqrt{4}-\sqrt{1}⟩ \\  & =⟨12,\,1⟩\end{aligned}
$$
